post.description: Requires a frozen current Result and no live Run. Record evidence in executing or verifying without advancing state; increment aggregate revision and atomically commit evidence/report, receipt, audit and outbox. Denied/stale/conflicting retries cannot create evidence. Human evidence requires the actual human session; qualified observations are required for other verifier kinds.
